title: netbox-system-services plugin
description: AGPL-3.0 NetBox 4.6 plugin: native SoT for a device's management-plane services (system identity, SNMP, syslog, NTP, DNS resolver), replacing the unstructured config_context blob. Mirrors the sibling netbox-pf plugin structure.

phases.title: Plugin skeleton & packaging
phases.exit_criteria: PluginConfig loads (name netbox_system_services, base_url system-services, min 4.6.0/max 4.6.99); pyproject installs; LICENSE + SPDX headers + .gitignore present.

items.description: __init__.py PluginConfig, setuptools pyproject (black 100, pytest DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE), AGPL LICENSE, Python .gitignore
SNMPAccess (ro/rw), SNMPVersion (v1/v2c), SyslogSeverity (debug/info/warning/error), SyslogFacility (user/local0..local7), SyslogTransport (udp/tcp/tls), DNSResolverMode (static/dhcp)

phases.title: Models (9) + hand-authored migration
phases.exit_criteria: All 9 models present; each config is OneToOne to dcim.Device (CASCADE); child rows FK to their config; ArrayFields on DNSResolverConfig; secrets kept out (logical name/ref only).

items.description: OneToOne Device; default_gateway, location (sysLocation), contact (sysContact); hostname = device.name (not stored)
agent (enabled, listen_interface); community (name=OpenBao key, access, restricted); trap target (target, port, version, community_ref=OpenBao key). Secret strings live in OpenBao, never NetBox.
policy (severity, facility, retention_days); remote server (host, port, transport)
roles (enabled, broadcast, serve_lan); upstream peer (host, prefer)
device's OWN stub resolver: mode (static/dhcp), ordered nameservers ArrayField, ordered search_domains ArrayField. NOT authoritative zones (netbox-dns).
Hand-authored, mirroring netbox-pf/netbox-fs: NetBoxModel base fields, OneToOne/FK, GenericIPAddressField, postgres ArrayField, taggit tags, unique constraint on SNMPCommunity(config,name)

phases.title: Plugin surface (UI + API + filters)
phases.exit_criteria: filtersets/forms/tables/navigation/views/urls and api/{serializers,views,urls} cover all 9 models; REST contract browsable; graphql placeholder present.

items.description: NetBoxModelFilterSet per model; explicit device_id/device + config_id FK filters; choice filters; search()
model forms (DynamicModelChoiceField + FieldSets) + filter forms per model
NetBoxTable per model; PluginMenu grouped System/SNMP/Syslog/NTP/DNS
NetBoxModelSerializer + NetBoxModelViewSet + NetBoxRouter for all 9 models — the contract ansible-tofu reads back
empty graphql/__init__.py mirroring netbox-pf (no GraphQL type yet)

phases.title: Tests (NO MOCKS, real DB)
phases.exit_criteria: test_models/test_api/test_filtersets cover every model/serializer/filterset/view via NetBox utilities.testing base classes against the real test DB.

items.description: creation, str, get_absolute_url, defaults, OneToOne-per-device uniqueness, SNMPCommunity unique-per-config, CASCADE, ArrayField order round-trip
APIViewTestCases CRUD mixins per model; distinct device per OneToOne create row; ArrayField create_data
device/config scoping + choice + search filters per filterset
